# Week map

A suggested mapping of the build guides onto a course's weeks. Adjust freely: nothing in the repo depends on
this file, it just saves re-deriving the order each time.

| Guide | Suggested week |
| --- | --- |
| 00-welcome | 1 |
| 01-prepare-the-workstation | 1 |
| 02-pfsense | 1 |
| 03-proxmox | 1 |
| 04-admin01 | 2 |
| 05-the-repo-inventory-and-secrets | 2 |
| 06-create-the-guests | 2 |
| 07-identity | 4 |
| 08-dns-dhcp-and-time | 4 |
| 09-squid | 5 |
| 10-docker-vm-and-apps | 5 |
| 11-single-sign-on | 7 |
| 12-mail | 6 |
| 13-file-transfer-and-shares | 7 |
| 14-wifi-radius | 7 |
| 15-monitoring-and-logs | 4 |
| 16-backup-and-restore | 9 |
| 17-windows-11-optional | 7 |
| 18-verify | 9 |

Weeks 12, 15 and 17 are the measure, harden, re-measure loop; see
[docs/how-it-works.md](../how-it-works.md) and `weeks/` for that part of the course.
